notes: Homepage title: 'Tuckernuck | Women's Clothing, Dresses, Shoes & Home'; banner 'Free Shipping & Returns', 'Now Offering Free Exchanges & Store Credit' (https://tnuck.com/).

About (https://tnuck.com/pages/about-us): 'Back in 2012, we couldn't find curated boutiques we loved close to home'; started by family and friends (Maddy, September, Jocelyn) 'who love color, stripes, bucket lists, and nostalgia'; based in Washington, DC; own labels Tuckernuck, Tnuck Sport, Tnuck Beach plus other designers; 'classic but never basic', 'standout dresses'. known_for 'Colorful, Classic Dresses' paraphrases these lines (human check).

kind retailer: Designers page lists in-house labels (Tuckernuck, Tuckernuck Cashmere, Tnuck Sport, Tnuck Beach and more) plus outside labels such as Barbour, Ulla Johnson, La DoubleJ, Lela Rose, MOTHER (https://tnuck.com/pages/designers); the dresses feed carries 83 labels in stock.

Shipping (https://tnuck.com/pages/shipping): US Standard free, 3–5 business days; Expedited $16; Next Day $30. Country selector offers Canada (CAD); no other countries listed, so ships_to is US and CA.

Returns (https://tnuck.com/pages/returns): returns and exchanges within 21 days of delivery; free in the US; free exchanges for a different size; store credit option; Final Sale and monogram items not returnable.
Stores (https://tnuck.com/pages/visit-our-stores): 1121 Madison Ave, New York, NY; 1267 Wisconsin Ave NW, Washington, DC; 23 Centre St, Nantucket, MA; a fourth marked Coming Soon.
Sizes from the own-label dresses feed options: XXS–XXXL letter sizes (some styles XXXXL) and numeric 0–16 on some styles (2026-10-29). No plus, petite or tall section checked, so flags stay empty.

Ahrefs top pages for tnuck.com (US, 2026-10-28): /collections/ladies-dresses is the highest-traffic page after the homepage (top keyword 'tuckernuck dresses'), followed by sale dresses and cocktail dresses.
